requirements: 骨架层：L1 实际运行 + L5 当前证据
复用preflight/effective policy/capability描述，明确supported/unsupported/unknown及probe来源和时间。
重测当前embedded runtime/CLI来源、配置schema、Gateway/cron/service；原研究包配置故障仅作待核对线索。
有缺口时做保留语义的备份/迁移/readback；使用已具备权限，不擅自安装管理员服务或改变冻结default。

acceptance.text: 一次isolated run与受控continuation有实际回执；UI关闭后的持续执行、重启恢复分别测量。
工具声明与实际adapter不符/未测budget/缺失service不能被投影为可用；失效状态回到现有诊断。
配置修复失败可回滚，UFTK等既有字段不盲删；无需用户亲自点UI验证。
负例：descriptor当runtime授权；旧探针当当前健康；保存配置成功当reload成功
证据包含driven_by:agent、真实actor、source/candidate/输入配置版本、命令/exit/count、artifact hash、负例与未测范围；不以stdout或模型自述收口。

configuration.reason: No config defect was observed. The read model and scope/liveness fixes add no config writer; actual boot, preserved runtime fields and existing owner sync tests prove preservation. Conditional failed-repair rollback was not invoked because no repair was introduced.

limitations: Scripted local provider is wiring evidence, not model quality.
No installed service, packaged distribution, budget measurement or release claim.
Supported runtime/scheduling observation is not permission, adapter health, service installation or effect admission.
Unknown budgets and service support deliberately stay unknown; no installer or app-exit-execution claim.
Full TF-0664 autonomy program remains incomplete; this acceptance covers TF-0674 only.
Global default-branch landing and publication are separate from this isolated source-candidate acceptance.
Two earlier completed Native attempts failed with connection closure; preserved in execution-interruptions.json. Their exact cause remains unproven; no reliability or soak claim.

knownExecutionResiduals.boundary: The original node requires an actual isolated run and continuation/restart scenario. This pack proves that finite scenario on the frozen candidate. It does not claim every attempt passed or establish stable long-running reliability; later project recovery/soak scope remains outside this leaf.
